verdict.rationale: treg's docs name /llms.txt as the file to point a coding agent at, saying it teaches the whole protocol in one fetch, and the homepage tells users to hand that URL to their agent. A probe confirmed llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with agent-oriented content. Markdown docs (tutorial.md, feedback.md) and an openapi.json are also served. Missing for 10: no independent or community report of an agent actually being onboarded via llms.txt, and the /docs.md markdown variant returns 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: [/llms.txt](/llms.txt) is the file to point a coding agent at — it teaches the whole protocol in one fetch.
Give this to your agent ... $ `set up treg - https://treg.to/llms.txt`
PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://treg.to/llms.txt # treg — the tool catalog for your agent
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://treg.to/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
